AmisA · Digital Laboratory

Working with AmisA LAB

Fast. Reliable. Design for Dentists. World Wide Service — Delivered in 12 business days or less.

Non-Prep & Ultra-Thin Ceramic Veneers

Translucent, natural-looking veneers with minimal or no tooth preparation required.

Full-Contour Zirconia & Lithium Disilicate

Durable, aesthetic crowns with exceptional strength and natural appearance.

Inlays, Onlays & Custom Esthetic Restorations

Precision-crafted indirect restorations for complex clinical cases.

CAD/CAM Digital Workflows

Full digital workflow from scan to restoration — compatible with all major scanners.

How to Submit a Case
1
Preparation & Scan
Prepare the case clinically and take digital impressions with your scanner.
2
Complete Work Sheet
Fill out our lab worksheet with full case specifications and shade selection. Open Worksheet Form →
3
Send PLY & STL Files
Email to amisa.biodental.tech@gmail.com — or search "AmisA Biodental Tech" in your MyiTero account and Shining 3D to send via iTero AND Shining 3D
Open Work Sheet →
